tours.title: Tour Packages & Guided Trips
tours.seoTitle: Tour Packages & Guided Trips | Sasta Milaga
tours.description: Compare tour packages and guided trips from travel agencies: itineraries, prices and inclusions in one place, alongside flights, hotels and Umrah options.
tours.body:
Find a trip that fits your dates and budget

Explore dated tour packages, guided activities, pilgrimage trips, and airport transfers listed by travel agencies on Sasta Milaga. Each listing should explain its route, departure date, duration, inclusions, cancellation terms, and price per traveller.

Choose a listed departure date and send a booking request. The travel agency must confirm availability and will contact you about payment and final arrangements. A request is not a confirmed ticket, hotel reservation, or paid booking.

Browse travel experiences

  • Multi-day tour packages
  • Guided tours and activities
  • Umrah and Hajj packages
  • Airport transfers

Available packages

Browse current listings, compare the full trip details, and check the agency's terms before requesting a place.

How a tour booking request works

  1. Select a package, departure date, and number of travellers.
  2. Submit your contact details. Do not enter a passport or CNIC number at this stage.
  3. The agency checks availability and contacts you to confirm the trip and explain payment terms.

Before you request a trip

Review what is included and excluded, pickup arrangements, accessibility or age requirements, cancellation terms, and any documents you may need later. Flight and hotel searches are completed on the provider's website; this page does not issue tickets or hotel reservations.

Are you a travel provider? Apply to become a Sasta Milaga travel partner. Agency applications and package listings are reviewed before they go live.

ur/terms.title: شرائط و ضوابط
ur/terms.seoTitle: شرائط و ضوابط | سستا ملے گا
ur/terms.description: سستا ملے گا سے خریداری کی شرائط: قیمتیں، آرڈر، کیش آن ڈیلیوری، ترسیل، واپسی اور ویب سائٹ کا استعمال۔
ur/terms.body:
اس ویب سائٹ پر آرڈر کر کے آپ ان شرائط سے اتفاق کرتے ہیں۔

قیمتیں اور پروڈکٹس

قیمتیں پاکستانی روپوں میں ہیں اور صرف پروڈکٹ کی ہیں؛ ترسیل کی فیس چیک آؤٹ پر دکھائی جاتی ہے۔ تصاویر پروڈکٹ کو ویسے دکھاتی ہیں جیسے اسٹور نے لسٹ کیا؛ "رینڈم کلر" والی اشیاء کا رنگ تصویر سے مختلف ہو سکتا ہے۔

آرڈر

آرڈر تب کنفرم ہوتا ہے جب ہم آپ سے رابطہ کریں یا اسے روانہ کر دیں۔ اسٹاک ختم ہونے، غلط قیمت دکھنے یا پتہ کنفرم نہ ہو سکنے کی صورت میں ہم آرڈر منسوخ کر سکتے ہیں۔

ادائیگی اور ترسیل

ادائیگی کیش آن ڈیلیوری کے ذریعے ہوتی ہے۔ ترسیل کی فیس اور وقت ترسیل کی معلومات میں درج ہیں۔

واپسی

واپسی واپسی اور رقم کی واپسی میں دیے گئے طریقے کے مطابق ہوتی ہے۔

رابطہ

ان شرائط کے بارے میں سوالات: رابطہ کریں۔

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.description: Terms for local HHC and prepaid CJ purchases, destination availability, display and checkout currencies, delivery, order confirmation and returns.
terms.body:
By placing an order on this website you agree to these terms.

Prices and products

Sasta Milaga Local local checkout is in PKR and Sasta Milaga Global prepaid checkout is in USD. Catalog prices converted into a selected display currency are estimates. Review the item amounts, delivery, applicable taxes, final total and payment currency at checkout. Photos show the product as listed by its store; for items marked “random colour”, the colour sent may differ from the photo.

Orders

An order is confirmed when we contact you or dispatch it. We may cancel an order if an item is out of stock, the price was shown in error, or we cannot reach you to confirm the address.

Payment and delivery

Sasta Milaga Local local products are available in Pakistan with cash on delivery only. Sasta Milaga Global products require prepaid payment to Sasta Milaga through an available checkout method, including deliveries to Pakistan. These collections use separate compatible payment flows. A catalog listing or country suggestion does not guarantee shipping availability, and payment confirmation is not a dispatch confirmation. Delivery charges and times are explained on Shipping & delivery.

Returns

Returns are handled as described on Returns & refunds.

Contact

Questions about these terms: Contact us.

Destination availability

Delivery depends on the product option, warehouse, carrier, complete address and available payment method. Estimates can change before checkout. Import duties and destination requirements can vary; contact support before paying if checkout does not explain their treatment. These terms do not limit mandatory rights that apply to your purchase.

ur/privacy.title: رازداری کی پالیسی
ur/privacy.seoTitle: رازداری کی پالیسی | سستا ملے گا
ur/privacy.description: آرڈر یا رابطے کے وقت سستا ملے گا کون سی ذاتی معلومات جمع کرتا ہے، کیوں، اور آپ انہیں درست یا حذف کرنے کے لیے کیسے کہہ سکتے ہیں۔
ur/privacy.body:
یہ پالیسی بتاتی ہے کہ ہم اس ویب سائٹ پر کون سی معلومات جمع کرتے ہیں اور ان کا کیا استعمال کرتے ہیں۔

ہم کیا جمع کرتے ہیں

  • آرڈر کرتے وقت: آپ کا نام، فون نمبر، ای میل (اختیاری)، ترسیل کا پتہ اور خریدی گئی اشیاء۔
  • رابطہ کرتے وقت: جو آپ رابطہ فارم یا واٹس ایپ پر لکھتے ہیں۔
  • براؤز کرتے وقت: کوکیز جو آپ کے کارٹ اور زبان کے انتخاب کو یاد رکھتی ہیں۔

ہم یہ معلومات کیوں استعمال کرتے ہیں

  • آپ کا آرڈر پہنچانے اور اس بارے میں رابطہ کرنے کے لیے۔
  • واپسی اور رقم کی واپسی کے لیے۔
  • آپ کے سوالات کے جواب دینے کے لیے۔

ہم یہ معلومات کس کو دیتے ہیں

آپ کا نام، فون اور پتہ آرڈر پہنچانے والے کورئیر کو دیا جاتا ہے۔ ہم آپ کی معلومات فروخت نہیں کرتے۔

آپ کے اختیارات

آپ رابطہ کر کے اپنی معلومات درست یا حذف کرنے کا کہہ سکتے ہیں۔ حساب اور واپسی کے لیے ضروری مدت تک ہم آرڈر کا ریکارڈ رکھتے ہیں۔

تلاش اور خریداری کا اسسٹنٹ

کیٹلاگ میں تلاش، مفہوم کی شناخت اور تصویر کی پہچان آپ کے اپنے آلے پر ہوتی ہے۔ ماڈل کی فائلیں عوامی سی ڈی این فراہم کنندگان سے ڈاؤن لوڈ ہوتی ہیں، جنہیں اس ڈاؤن لوڈ کی معمول کی نیٹ ورک معلومات ملتی ہیں۔ ہماری تصویری تلاش آپ کی منتخب کردہ تصویر آپ کے آلے پر پڑھتی ہے اور اسے اپ لوڈ نہیں کرتی۔ آواز کی شناخت کے لیے آپ کے براؤزر کی فراہم کردہ سروس استعمال ہو سکتی ہے؛ مائیکروفون استعمال کرنے سے پہلے اس کی اجازتیں اور رازداری کی ترتیبات دیکھیں۔

حالیہ تلاشیں آپ کے براؤزر میں محفوظ رہتی ہیں اور اسسٹنٹ کی گفتگو براؤزر کے موجودہ سیشن تک محفوظ رہتی ہے۔ جب آپ رضامندی سے پیغام بھیجتے ہیں تو آپ کا نام، رابطے کی معلومات، پیغام اور اسسٹنٹ کی گفتگو اس اسٹور کو بھیجی جاتی ہیں، ورڈپریس میں نجی طور پر محفوظ ہوتی ہیں اور اسٹور کی اطلاع کے عمل میں شامل کی جاتی ہیں۔ اپنے پیغام یا محفوظ معلومات کے بارے میں مدد کے لیے رابطے کا صفحہ استعمال کریں۔

مائیکروسافٹ کلیئرٹی تجزیات

ہم اس ویب سائٹ پر آنے والوں کے تعامل کو سمجھنے کے لیے Microsoft Clarity استعمال کرتے ہیں۔ یہ صفحات دیکھنے، کلکس اور اسکرول جیسی براؤزنگ اور تعامل کی معلومات جمع کر سکتا ہے، اور تجزیات کے لیے سیشن ری پلے اور کوکیز (بشمول _clck اور _clsk) استعمال کر سکتا ہے۔ کوکیز کا طریقہ آپ کے علاقے اور Clarity کی رضامندی کی ترتیبات پر منحصر ہے؛ آپ اپنے براؤزر میں کوکیز کا انتظام کر سکتے ہیں۔ Microsoft کے رازداری کے بیان میں مزید پڑھیں۔ Microsoft Privacy Statement

بین الاقوامی آرڈر اور ترسیلی پارٹنرز

گلوبل کلیکشن کی مصنوعات کی ترسیل کے لیے ہم اس آرڈر کے لیے ضروری معلومات (وصول کنندہ کا نام، پتہ، فون، ضرورت ہو تو ای میل اور آرڈر کی اشیاء) اپنے بین الاقوامی ترسیلی پارٹنر اور کورئیرز (جیسے DHL اور ڈاک سروس) کو دیتے ہیں۔ یہ معلومات آپ کے ملک سے باہر، بشمول چین، صرف آرڈر کی تکمیل اور ترسیل کے لیے استعمال ہو سکتی ہیں۔ ہم آپ کی ذاتی معلومات فروخت نہیں کرتے۔ اپنی معلومات دیکھنے، درست کرنے یا حذف کرنے کے لیے رابطہ صفحہ استعمال کریں۔

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How Sasta Milaga collects, uses and protects your data: orders, worldwide fulfilment partners and carriers, payments, cookies, analytics and your privacy rights.
privacy.body:
This policy explains what information we collect on this website and how we use it.

What we collect

  • When you order: your name, phone number, email where required by checkout, delivery address and the items you buy.
  • When you contact us: what you write in the contact form or on WhatsApp.
  • When you browse: cookies that keep your cart and language choice working.

Why we use it

  • To deliver your order and contact you about it.
  • To handle returns and refunds.
  • To answer your questions.

Who we share it with

Your name, phone and address are given to the courier delivering your order. We do not sell your information.

Your choices

You can ask us to correct or delete your information by contacting us. We keep order records as long as we need them for accounting and returns.

Search and shopping assistant

Some search, semantic matching and image recognition features run on your device. Support questions and bounded catalog searches can also be sent to this store to retrieve relevant public products and current shopping guidance. Model files are downloaded from public CDN providers, which receive the normal network details of that download. Our image search reads the photo you choose on your device and does not upload it. Voice recognition may use your browser provider’s speech service; check its permissions and privacy settings before using the microphone.

Recent searches are kept in your browser storage, and assistant history is kept for the browser session. When you agree to submit an enquiry, your name, contact details, message and assistant conversation are sent to this store, saved privately in WordPress and included in the store’s notification workflow. Use the contact page if you need help with your enquiry or stored details.

Analytics and Microsoft Clarity

We use Microsoft Clarity to understand how visitors interact with this site. It may collect browsing and interaction information such as page views, clicks, and scrolling, and may use session replay and cookies (including _clck and _clsk) for analytics. Cookie behavior depends on your region and the consent settings configured for Clarity; you can manage cookies through your browser. Read the Microsoft Privacy Statement.

Country preferences, fulfillment and payment providers

Cloudflare can provide an approximate country from your network address. We use country, language and currency preferences to present the relevant shopping experience; this does not supply your exact delivery address. Your browser may store those preferences and the cart/session details needed for checkout.

Where necessary to quote delivery or fulfil your purchase, destination and order details are shared with the relevant fulfilment service and carrier (see below). Payment processing is handled through the payment method you select and its provider. Do not send full card details, passwords or one-time codes through the shopping assistant or WhatsApp.

Regional WhatsApp contacts and simulator

Choosing a WhatsApp contact opens the corresponding external service and is subject to its privacy practices. The support simulator is a test interface: it retrieves read-only guidance and public catalog information and does not send WhatsApp messages, place orders or book calls. Public chat does not reveal private order details; use the authenticated account or verified support process.

Translation services

When external machine translation is enabled, public product or page text may be sent to the configured provider for translation under its terms. This workflow does not authorize sending customer account, payment, address or private order data for translation. Machine-generated wording may need review, especially for product facts and business policies.

International orders and fulfilment partners

To deliver items from our global collection, we share the details needed for that order (recipient name, delivery address, phone number, email where required, and the items ordered) with our international fulfilment partner and the carriers that deliver it, such as DHL and national postal services. They may process this information outside your country, including in China and the countries where their warehouses and carriers operate, and may use it only to fulfil and deliver your order. Customs authorities can receive shipment details as required by law. We do not sell your personal information.

Your privacy rights

Depending on where you live (for example the UK, EU, UAE, Saudi Arabia, California or Pakistan), you can ask to access, correct, delete or receive a copy of your personal information, or object to certain uses. Contact us through the contact page; we may need to verify your identity, and we keep order records for as long as accounting, tax and return obligations require.

ur/safe-shopping.title: محفوظ خریداری
ur/safe-shopping.seoTitle: پاکستان میں محفوظ آن لائن خریداری کے طریقے | سستا ملے گا
ur/safe-shopping.description: آن لائن خریداری کو محفوظ بنائیں: ادائیگی سے پہلے پارسل چیک کریں، کبھی OTP شیئر نہ کریں اور صرف سستا ملے گا کے سرکاری رابطے استعمال کریں۔
ur/safe-shopping.body:
چند عادتیں آن لائن خریداری کو محفوظ رکھتی ہیں، اس سائٹ پر بھی اور ہر جگہ بھی۔

جب پارسل پہنچے

  • چیک کریں کہ پارسل پر نام اور آرڈر کی تفصیل آپ کی ہے۔
  • اگر پیکنگ بری طرح خراب ہو تو کھولنے سے پہلے تصویر لے لیں۔
  • جب تک آپ مطمئن نہ ہوں پیکنگ سنبھال کر رکھیں، تاکہ ضرورت پڑنے پر واپسی ہو سکے۔

اپنی رقم محفوظ رکھیں

  • ہم کبھی OTP، PIN یا کارڈ پاس ورڈ نہیں مانگتے۔ آرڈر کے بارے میں کال کرنے والے کسی شخص کو یہ نہ بتائیں۔
  • ہمارا واٹس ایپ نمبر +92 343 2601806 ہے، جو اس سائٹ کے ہر صفحے پر بھی درج ہے۔ ہمارے نام سے دوسرے نمبروں سے آنے والے پیغامات سے ہوشیار رہیں۔
  • کیش آن ڈیلیوری میں آپ ادائیگی صرف تب کرتے ہیں جب پارسل آپ کے ہاتھ میں ہو۔

کچھ غلط لگے؟

اپنے آرڈر نمبر کے ساتھ رابطہ کریں، ہم چیک کریں گے۔

safe-shopping.title: Safe shopping
safe-shopping.seoTitle: Safe Shopping & Payment Advice | Sasta Milaga
safe-shopping.description: Check order details, protect payment security codes and use official Sasta Milaga support. HHC Pakistan orders use COD; CJ purchases are prepaid.
safe-shopping.body:
A few habits keep online shopping safe, on this site and everywhere else.

When the parcel arrives

  • Check that the name and order details on the parcel are yours.
  • If the packaging is badly damaged, take a photo before opening it.
  • Keep the packaging until you are happy with the item, in case you need a return.

Protect your money

  • We never ask for an OTP, PIN or card password. Do not share them with anyone who calls about an order.
  • Our WhatsApp number is +92 343 2601806, and it is also shown on every page of this site. Be careful with messages from other numbers claiming to be us.
  • Cash on delivery applies only to Sasta Milaga Local local products in Pakistan. Pay the courier the confirmed amount when the order is delivered. Sasta Milaga Global products require prepaid checkout; do not send payment-card details or security codes through chat.

Something looks wrong?

Contact us with your order number and we will check it.

ur/faq.title: اکثر پوچھے جانے والے سوالات
ur/faq.seoTitle: اکثر پوچھے جانے والے سوالات | سستا ملے گا
ur/faq.description: ترسیل کی فیس اور وقت، کیش آن ڈیلیوری، واپسی، رقم کی واپسی اور آرڈر کرنے کے طریقے کے بارے میں جوابات۔
ur/faq.body:
آرڈر اور ادائیگی

آرڈر کیسے کروں؟

پروڈکٹس کارٹ میں ڈالیں، کارٹ کھولیں، چیک آؤٹ دبائیں، اپنی تفصیل لکھیں اور کیش آن ڈیلیوری منتخب کریں۔ مکمل طریقہ: آرڈر کیسے کریں۔

کیا کیش آن ڈیلیوری ممکن ہے؟

جی ہاں۔ چیک آؤٹ پر کیش آن ڈیلیوری منتخب کریں اور پارسل ملنے پر کورئیر کو ادائیگی کریں۔

کیا اکاؤنٹ بنانا ضروری ہے؟

نہیں۔ آپ صرف نام، فون نمبر اور پتے کے ساتھ بطور مہمان آرڈر کر سکتے ہیں۔

ترسیل

ترسیل کی فیس کتنی ہے؟

پورے پاکستان میں 250 روپے۔ 5,000 روپے سے زائد کے آرڈر مفت۔

ترسیل میں کتنا وقت لگتا ہے؟

عموماً بڑے شہروں میں 2 سے 4 اور دیگر علاقوں میں 3 سے 6 ورکنگ دن۔ تفصیل: ترسیل کی معلومات۔

واپسی

کیا میں آئٹم واپس کر سکتا ہوں؟

جی ہاں، ترسیل کے 7 دن کے اندر۔ خراب یا غلط آئٹم کی واپسی مفت، دیگر پر 250 روپے فیس۔ تفصیل: واپسی اور رقم کی واپسی۔

رقم کیسے واپس ملے گی؟

واپس شدہ آئٹم ملنے کے بعد رقم 7 سے 10 ورکنگ دنوں میں آپ کے بینک اکاؤنٹ، جاز کیش یا ایزی پیسہ میں بھیج دی جاتی ہے۔

پروڈکٹس

پروڈکٹس کون فروخت کرتا ہے؟

ہر پروڈکٹ پیج پر اسٹور کا نام لکھا ہے۔ آپ اسٹور کھول کر اس کی تمام پروڈکٹس دیکھ سکتے ہیں۔

"رینڈم کلر" کا کیا مطلب ہے؟

کچھ آئٹمز میں رنگ آپ منتخب نہیں کرتے؛ دستیاب رنگوں میں سے کوئی ایک بھیجا جاتا ہے۔ ایسی صورت میں پروڈکٹ کے نام میں یہ لکھا ہوتا ہے۔

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.seoTitle: Shopping FAQs: Payments, Shipping & Returns | Sasta Milaga
faq.description: Answers about HHC Pakistan cash on delivery, CJ prepaid orders, destination shipping, checkout currencies, tracking and returns at Sasta Milaga.
faq.body:
Ordering, destinations and payment

Which products can I buy in my country?

Choose your shopping destination in the site header. Sasta Milaga Local local products are available in Pakistan only. Sasta Milaga Global products require a supported shipping service and prepaid checkout for the selected option and delivery address. A catalog listing does not guarantee delivery to every country.

How do I place an order?

Open a product, select its option and quantity, then use Add to cart or Buy Now. Check the item price, shipping, payment currency and total before placing your order. See the ordering steps.

Is cash on delivery available?

Cash on delivery is available for Sasta Milaga Local local products in Pakistan only. Sasta Milaga Global products require prepaid payment to Sasta Milaga through a method offered at checkout, including when the delivery address is in Pakistan.

Can I mix Sasta Milaga Local and Sasta Milaga Global products?

These collections use different payment and fulfillment arrangements. Complete them as separate compatible checkouts; do not use Sasta Milaga Local cash on delivery to pay for a Sasta Milaga Global item.

Are displayed currencies the final payment currency?

A converted catalog price is an estimate. Sasta Milaga Local local checkout uses PKR; Sasta Milaga Global checkout uses USD. The payment currency and final charge are shown in the WooCommerce order review. Your payment provider may apply its own conversion charges.

Do I need an account?

Guest checkout may be available. Sign in to use member rewards and wallet benefits that are eligible for your cart, or to view your account order history.

Shipping and returns

How much is delivery?

For the Sasta Milaga Local local Pakistan collection, delivery is Rs 250 and is free above Rs 5,000 under the current local shipping arrangement. Sasta Milaga Global shipping is quoted separately using the option, quantity, warehouse and delivery address. Read shipping and delivery details.

How long does delivery take?

The local Pakistan guide is usually 2-4 working days for major cities and 3-6 elsewhere after confirmation. Sasta Milaga Global estimates depend on the shipping service and destination. Estimates are not a guaranteed dispatch or arrival date.

How can I track an order?

Sign in to My account and open your order. Tracking appears after a supplier or carrier provides it. Support can help verify an order without exposing another customer's information in public chat.

How do returns and refunds work?

Contact us within 7 days of delivery to request help and keep the packaging and evidence of any damage or incorrect item. Read Returns and refunds before sending anything back. International returns require confirmed instructions and a return address; the Pakistan local return fee is not an international shipping quote.

Can I speak to a regional team?

Visit Contact us for the owner-provided regional WhatsApp directory. All listed teams can be selected when your destination has no suggested regional contact. Response times depend on staff availability.

What does random colour mean?

The supplied colour may be one of the available colours rather than the exact photograph. Choose a specific option where the product offers one; a random-colour listing does not promise colour selection.

returns.title: Returns & refunds
returns.seoTitle: Returns & Refunds Policy: Pakistan and International Orders | Sasta Milaga
returns.description: Report damaged, wrong or missing items within 7 days. Free returns on our mistakes, refunds to your original payment method, and rules for international orders.
returns.body:
Contact Sasta Milaga to request a return within 7 days of receiving your order. Keep your order number and, for a damaged, defective or incorrect item, clear photos and a short video showing the problem and the parcel label. Any mandatory consumer rights that apply in your country continue to apply in addition to this policy.

Pakistan collection returns

  • Free return delivery for items that arrive damaged or where the wrong item was sent.
  • For other accepted returns sent by mail, the return delivery fee is Rs 250.
  • You can also return an eligible item in person at Sector 5-M, North Karachi, Karachi 75850, Sindh, Pakistan. Contact support first with your order number; do not leave an item without confirmation from our team.
  • Keep the item unused and in its original packaging where possible.

Global collection returns (international orders)

  • Damaged, defective or wrong item: report it within 7 days of delivery with photos and video. After review we arrange a replacement or a refund, at no extra cost to you.
  • Item not received: if tracking shows no delivery 30 days after the latest estimated delivery date, contact us and we will investigate with the carrier and arrange a replacement or refund if the parcel is lost.
  • Personalised or custom-made items cannot be returned or exchanged unless they have a quality defect.
  • Change of mind: where your local law gives you a right to cancel an online purchase (for example 14 days in the UK and EU), you can use it: tell us within that period and return the item unused; the return shipping cost is yours unless the item was faulty.
  • Always contact us before sending anything back. Do not send items to a warehouse or to the address printed on the packaging; we will give you the correct return address, and parcels sent without authorisation may not be accepted.
  • Wrong or incomplete addresses entered at checkout, refused deliveries and unpaid import duties are not eligible for a free reshipment.

Refunds

  • Pakistan collection returned by mail: refund within 7–10 working days after we receive the item, to an agreed bank account, JazzCash or EasyPaisa.
  • Accepted in-store returns: refund processing within 7 days.
  • Prepaid and international orders: refunded to the original payment method once approved; your bank or payment provider may take extra days to show it.
  • We will tell you when a request is received, approved and completed; a refund is never described as completed before it is processed.

How to request help

Message your regional support team or use the contact page with your order number, the item, the delivery date and the issue. Never share an account password, card security code or one-time code.

Returns questions

How long do I have to report a problem?

7 days from delivery for damaged, defective or wrong items, with photos and a video. Lost parcels can be reported 30 days after the latest estimated delivery date.

Do I pay for return shipping?

Not when the item is damaged, defective or wrong. For change-of-mind returns, the return shipping cost is yours (Rs 250 for mailed Pakistan returns).

Can I return an international order?

Yes, for damaged, defective, wrong or lost items, and where your local law gives a right to cancel. Contact us first so we can give you the correct return address.

See also Shipping & delivery and Terms & conditions.

ur/shipping.title: ترسیل کی معلومات
ur/shipping.seoTitle: پاکستان میں ترسیل کی فیس اور وقت | سستا ملے گا
ur/shipping.description: پورے پاکستان میں ترسیل 250 روپے، 5,000 روپے سے زائد پر مفت۔ بڑے شہر 2 سے 4 اور دیگر علاقے 3 سے 6 ورکنگ دن۔
ur/shipping.body:
سستا ملے گا پورے پاکستان اور دنیا بھر میں ترسیل کرتا ہے۔ ترسیل کا طریقہ اس بات پر منحصر ہے کہ چیز ہمارے پاکستان کلیکشن (مقامی اسٹاک، کیش آن ڈیلیوری) میں ہے یا گلوبل کلیکشن میں (بین الاقوامی پارٹنر گوداموں سے دنیا بھر میں)۔ چیک آؤٹ ادائیگی سے پہلے آپ کے پتے کے لیے ترسیل کے آپشن اور فیس دکھاتا ہے۔

ہم کہاں ترسیل کرتے ہیں

پاکستان کلیکشن: پاکستان میں ترسیل

  • اہل مقامی مصنوعات پر کیش آن ڈیلیوری دستیاب ہے۔
  • مقامی ترسیل کی فیس 250 روپے؛ 5,000 روپے سے زیادہ کے آرڈر پر مفت ترسیل۔
  • عام طور پر بڑے شہروں میں 2 سے 4 اور دیگر علاقوں میں 3 سے 6 کاروباری دن۔

گلوبل کلیکشن: دنیا بھر میں ترسیل

  • گلوبل مصنوعات کی ادائیگی پیشگی ہوتی ہے، پاکستان کے لیے بھی؛ ان پر کیش آن ڈیلیوری نہیں۔
  • چیک آؤٹ پر دستیاب شپنگ سروس منتخب کریں؛ ہر آپشن فیس اور متوقع ترسیل کا وقت دکھاتا ہے۔
  • جہاں دستیاب ہو ایکسپریس (جیسے DHL) اور ٹریک ایبل سروسز؛ کچھ دور دراز ممالک میں صرف ڈاک سروس ہوتی ہے جس کی ٹریکنگ محدود ہو سکتی ہے۔
  • مختلف گوداموں کی چیزیں الگ پارسلوں میں آ سکتی ہیں۔

کسٹم، درآمدی ڈیوٹی اور ٹیکس

بین الاقوامی پارسلوں پر منزل کا ملک درآمدی ڈیوٹی، VAT/GST اور کسٹم فیس لگا سکتا ہے۔ اگر چیک آؤٹ پر یہ شامل نہ دکھائی جائیں تو وصول کنندہ سے کسٹم یا کورئیر یہ رقم وصول کر سکتا ہے۔

شپنگ کے سوالات

کیا آپ دنیا بھر میں ترسیل کرتے ہیں؟

جی ہاں۔ گلوبل کلیکشن کی مصنوعات امریکہ، برطانیہ، یورپ، خلیجی ممالک، افریقہ، آسٹریلیا اور نیوزی لینڈ سمیت دنیا بھر میں بھیجی جاتی ہیں۔ پاکستان کلیکشن صرف پاکستان میں۔

کیا پاکستان سے باہر کیش آن ڈیلیوری ممکن ہے؟

نہیں۔ کیش آن ڈیلیوری صرف پاکستان میں اہل مقامی مصنوعات پر ہے۔

shipping.title: Shipping & delivery
shipping.seoTitle: Shipping & Delivery: Worldwide on Global Items, COD in Pakistan | Sasta Milaga
shipping.description: Worldwide delivery on global items to the USA, UK, Europe, Gulf, Africa, Australia and New Zealand, plus cash on delivery across Pakistan. Charges, times, customs and tracking.
shipping.body:
Sasta Milaga delivers across Pakistan and worldwide. How an order ships depends on the collection the item belongs to: our Pakistan collection (local stock with cash on delivery) or our global collection (shipped from international partner warehouses to customers around the world). Each product page shows which collection it belongs to, and checkout confirms the delivery options and charges for your address before you pay.

Where we deliver

Browse items that ship to your country in the global shop. If checkout shows no delivery option for your address, that item cannot currently be sent there.

Pakistan collection: delivery within Pakistan

  • Cash on delivery is available on eligible local items.
  • Local delivery charge: Rs 250. Orders above Rs 5,000 qualify for free local delivery.
  • Usual delivery time: 2–4 working days in major cities and 3–6 working days in other areas after order confirmation.
  • Holidays, weather, address problems and courier operations can cause delays.

Global collection: worldwide delivery

  • Global items are prepaid, including deliveries to Pakistan. Cash on delivery is not available for them.
  • At checkout you choose an available shipping service. Each option shows its charge and an estimated delivery window for your full address; the product price does not include shipping.
  • Orders are processed after payment is confirmed. Delivery estimates are not guaranteed dispatch or arrival dates.
  • Express services (such as DHL) and standard tracked services are offered where available. Some remote destinations are served only by postal services, which may show limited or no tracking.
  • Remote-area surcharges, where they apply, are included in the quote shown at checkout.
  • Items from different warehouses can arrive in separate parcels.

Customs, import duties and taxes

International parcels can be subject to import duties, VAT/GST and customs handling fees set by the destination country. Unless checkout shows these amounts as included, they are not part of your payment to us and may be collected from the recipient by customs or the courier. Customs clearance can take longer in some destinations, including parts of Africa, South Asia and Latin America. Please check your country's import rules before ordering, and contact us before paying if you are unsure.

Address and delivery details

Enter a complete address with city, state or province, postal code and a phone number the courier can reach. Check it carefully before paying: a parcel sent to an incomplete or incorrect address may be returned or lost, and re-delivery can cost extra.

Tracking your order

Tracking appears in your orders and on the Track your order page once the courier provides it. A paid or processing order is not yet a dispatch confirmation. If tracking stops updating for an extended period, contact us with your order number.

Shipping questions

Do you deliver worldwide?

Yes. Items in our global collection ship to customers worldwide, including the USA, UK, Europe, the Gulf, Africa, Australia and New Zealand. Items in our Pakistan collection are delivered within Pakistan only.

How long does international delivery take?

It depends on the shipping service and your address. Checkout shows an estimated delivery window for each available service before you pay; express services are faster than standard and postal services.

Will I pay customs duties?

Possibly. Import duties and taxes are set by your country. Unless checkout shows them as included, the recipient may be asked to pay them on delivery.

Can I pay cash on delivery outside Pakistan?

No. Cash on delivery is available only for eligible Pakistan-collection items delivered in Pakistan. Global items are prepaid.

Can I order for someone in Pakistan from abroad?

Yes. Set your delivery country to Pakistan and enter the recipient's Pakistani address; local items and cash on delivery then become available.

See also Returns & refunds, Privacy policy and FAQ, or contact us.

how-to-order.title: How to order
how-to-order.seoTitle: How to Order: Local and Global Shopping | Sasta Milaga
how-to-order.description: Choose your destination and product options, check shipping and pay securely. HHC Pakistan orders use COD; CJ orders use prepaid checkout in USD.
how-to-order.body:
Choose products for your destination, review their options and confirm the final delivery and payment details before placing an order.

1. Set your destination

The site can suggest a country using Cloudflare geolocation. You can change your shopping destination in the header. The destination controls the collection you browse; checkout still needs an accurate delivery address.

2. Choose a product and option

Search by product name or SKU, or browse a category. Select the available option, origin where offered, and quantity. Product videos and photographs help explain the listing; specifications and stock must come from the actual product information.

3. Add to cart or Buy Now

Use Add to cart to keep shopping, or Buy Now to continue to checkout. Sasta Milaga Local local products and Sasta Milaga Global prepaid products use separate compatible payment flows. Review quantities and remove anything you do not want before continuing.

4. Confirm shipping and the final price

Enter your name, reachable phone number and complete delivery address. Sasta Milaga Global shipping services and charges are calculated for the selected option and destination. Review the item amounts, shipping, applicable taxes and the final total.

5. Choose the applicable payment method

Sasta Milaga Local products are cash on delivery in Pakistan only, with checkout in PKR. Sasta Milaga Global products require prepaid payment to Sasta Milaga through a method available at checkout, including deliveries to Pakistan; Sasta Milaga Global checkout is in USD. A displayed converted price is an estimate, and the checkout review confirms the payment currency. Eligible member rewards appear after signing in.

6. Keep your order number

Save the confirmation and follow your order in My account. Payment confirmation and supplier processing do not by themselves mean the parcel has shipped. Tracking is added when it becomes available.

For help, use the regional support directory. Never send a password, one-time code or full payment-card details in chat.

Already ordered? Track your order with your order number and email to see live delivery progress.

about.title: About Sasta Milaga
about.seoTitle: About Sasta Milaga | Local & Global Shopping
about.description: Learn how Karachi-based Sasta Milaga handles HHC Pakistan cash-on-delivery orders, prepaid CJ purchases, supplier fulfillment and customer support.
about.body:
Sasta Milaga is an online store operated from Karachi, Pakistan. We offer local Sasta Milaga Local products for Pakistan and prepaid Sasta Milaga Global products for supported delivery destinations.

What you can buy

The catalogue covers fashion, health and beauty, home and living, electronics and appliances, automotive accessories, books and stationery, toys, travel gear, groceries and more. Product pages show the available product information, options, photographs and, where supplied, videos. Sasta Milaga Local checkout uses Pakistani rupees (PKR); Sasta Milaga Global checkout uses US dollars (USD). Other displayed currencies are estimates.

Sasta Milaga is run from Karachi. Address: Sector 5-M, North Karachi, Karachi 75850, Sindh, Pakistan. Email: info@sastamilaga.com.

How we sell

  • You place your product order with Sasta Milaga, and we handle order support. Our suppliers fulfill and dispatch products directly to your delivery address.
  • Sasta Milaga Local local products are available in Pakistan with cash on delivery only. Sasta Milaga Global products require prepaid payment to Sasta Milaga through an available checkout method, including for deliveries to Pakistan.
  • Sasta Milaga Local local delivery is Rs 250, free above Rs 5,000. Sasta Milaga Global shipping is quoted separately for the selected option, warehouse and delivery address. The warehouse shown at checkout may be outside your country. A listing does not guarantee delivery to every destination. See Shipping & delivery.
  • Contact Sasta Milaga within 7 days of delivery to request a return. The local Sasta Milaga Local and international Sasta Milaga Global arrangements differ; confirm the instructions before sending a parcel back. See Returns & refunds.
  • Support on WhatsApp: +92 343 2601806, 9 AM to 9 PM Pakistan time, Monday to Saturday.

Talk to us

Questions about a product or an order? Contact us or read the FAQ.
